messages:
marco (partnerships): quick thread  BlueArc + EdgeHub want a joint session for the marketplace launch + on-device demo. target audience: platform engineers + infra buyers. need to finalize speakers, short demo plan, and swag before promo starts next week. who can jump on a 15m sync?

sam (eng): available. two quick infra questions: is the on-device demo running on partner HW or on our dev box emulating it? and what model precision are we showcasing (fp16 vs int8)?

dina (solutions): partners want real-device demo (EdgeHub hardware) + a 2nd segment showing 1-click deploy from the cloud marketplace. suggest a 9min device demo + 9min marketplace demo + 15m Q&A. I can draft the step-by-step runbook.

xia (marketing): promo timeline: social + email go out Tue. need speaker headshot + 40-60 word bio + 2-line session blurb by Monday noon. also need to confirm recording rights and whether partners want the on-demand video gated.

harry (ops): swag budget sits at $1.8k for this event. shipping internationally adds cost. options that fit: 150 stickers + 75 insulated water bottles, or 200 stickers + 100 branded mousepads. bottles are higher margin for attendee delight but heavier.

marco (partnerships): thanks. @dina can you suggest demo commands so sam can size infra? @xia I'll collect marketing deliverables; do partners need logo lockups?

legal-review-bot: please attach draft announcement and speaker list for review. ETA 72 hours for contract/legal review comments.

sam (eng): infra note: for on-device live demo we only need a lightweight local VM to proxy logs. for the marketplce deploy demo we should provision a small transient cluster: 1x A30 or A10-equivalent for the demo run (handles fp16 with 5 concurrent sessions). If we show int8 quantized model, a single T4 pair is fine. Need short-lived API key and CORS allowlist for the live site.

dina (solutions): runbook (rough):
```
00:00 host intro + goals (3m)
03:00 EdgeHub device demo - live Q&A latency (9m)
12:30 quick marketplace deploy - from listing to API call (9m)
22:00 integration highlight - BlueArc storage + Redwood caching (6m)
28:00 open Q&A (12m)
```
I'll put a polished runbook in the shared drive and tag the partners. demo snippet for marketplace: 
```
# quick deploy (example)
curl -s -X POST https://marketplace.edgehub.io/deploy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer DEMO_KEY" \
  -d '{"package":"redwood-edge-quant","region":"eu-west-1"}'
```

xia (marketing): rehearsal windows? I'm proposing Wed 11:00-12:00 PT or Thu 09:00-10:30 PT. calendar-bot can you propose both and see what partners accept?

calendar-bot: tentative invites sent for Wed 11:00-12:00 PT and Thu 09:00-10:30 PT. please RSVP by EOD Tuesday.

harry (ops): swag ops: recommend mousepads over bottles to reduce DHL paperwork. lead time ~10 business days after PO. need final SKU by Monday to hit shipping. I can handle fulfillment if partners supply EU customs info.

marco (partnerships): action items recap: dina -> runbook + partner diagram (due Mon), sam -> infra sizing + demo keys (due Mon), xia -> landing copy + bios + logo lockups request (due Mon), harry -> finalize swag SKU & PO (due Mon), legal-review-bot -> review announcement (ETA 72h). I'll coordinate speaker confirmations with EdgeHub/BlueArc.

xia (marketing): one more ask  partners, please provide a 1-slide architecture diagram (SVG) and confirm logo usage. if partners want co-branded landing gate, flag now.

dina (solutions): will request diagrams from both partners and add to the runbook.

harry (ops): noted. no issues from ops side unless shipping addresses are restricted.

marco (partnerships): ok closing the loop. I'll convert this thread into a tracking doc and ping assignees. thanks all :v:
